prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a rear-end collision. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1097; do not mention it.)
text:
This firm represents our client in connection with injuries sustained in a rear-end collision involving a vehicle insured under your policy. Please direct all further communications regarding this matter to our office and do not contact our client directly, whether by telephone, letter, or in person. If your insured or any representative has already been in contact with our client, please let us know so that we can address it.

We request that you provide the bodily injury liability limits of the policy in force at the time of the accident, along with a certified copy of the declarations page and a statement of any other coverage that may apply to this loss. Please also confirm the name of the adjuster assigned to this claim.

We further ask that your company preserve all evidence relating to this incident. This includes the claim file, photographs, recorded statements, vehicle repair and total-loss records, telematics or event data recorder information, dash camera footage, and all correspondence with your insured. Please suspend any routine deletion or disposal procedures that could affect these materials.

Please acknowledge receipt of this letter within fourteen days.
